record Point:
    x: int
    y: int

enum Colour:
    red
    green


enum Shape:
    dot
    span(value: int)

func pick(n: int) -> Result[int, str]:
    if n < 0:
        return Err("nope")
    return Ok(n)

func main(out: Stream) -> int:
    out.print(Point(x=1, y=2), Colour.green, Colour.red)
    mut found: int? = Some(4)
    mut missing: int? = None
    out.print(pick(3), pick(-1), found, missing)
    mut dot: Shape = Shape.dot
    mut span: Shape = Shape.span(value=7)
    out.print(dot, span)
    return 0

record Inner:
    label: str
    values: int[]

record Outer:
    inner: Inner
    flag: bool

func main(out: Stream) -> int:
    mut value = Outer(inner=Inner(label="deep", values=[1, 2]), flag=False)
    out.print(value)
    out.print([value])
    mut box: Outer? = Some(value)
    out.print(box)
    mut table: dict[str, Outer] = {"one": value}
    out.print(table)
    return 0
